title: River Development Agent Governed Executor Integration Active Admission Authorization Foundation
objective: Authorize an exact trusted DEV-301 active-admission eligibility result for a future separately governed active-admission boundary while creating no admission, dispatch, execution, mutation, network, secret, shell, or external-side-effect authority.
constraints: DEV-301 eligibility state must be ACTIVE_ADMISSION_ELIGIBLE.
DEV-301 must remain an active-admission eligibility decision only.
DEV-301 eligibility result must remain inert data.
DEV-301 must require a future active-admission authorization boundary.
DEV-301 blocked reasons must be empty.
Required predecessor lineage and evidence must be present.
All inherited and downstream authorities must remain denied.
Authorization must not itself admit, activate admission, dispatch, invoke an executor, or execute an operation.
Authorization must not modify, delete, stage, commit, push, or deploy repository content.
Authorization must not access secrets, expand scope, perform arbitrary shell execution, perform network execution, or perform external side effects.
A future separately governed active-admission boundary remains required.
